The Hawaiian Islands rarely see significant hurricane damage, but they just experienced the effects of their second hurricane in a year as Hurricane Lowell’s eyewall brushed Niihau, west of Kauai, on Sept. 8, 2026.

The hurricane brought heavy downpours, high surf and hurricane-force wind gusts that pounded both islands, knocking out power and flooding roads. Tropical storm conditions reached as far as Honolulu on the island of Oahu.
results.title: A second hurricane just sideswiped Hawaii – why the islands’ usual force field seems to be down in 2026

As of Saturday, the National Hurricane Center forecasts no tropical development in the next seven days.

With six days until Sept. 11, the possibility remains that the 2026 season will set a new record for the latest first hurricane. It will already make the Top 5 list for latest first hurricanes, since passing the anniversary of Arlene on Sept. 2.

The average Atlantic hurricane season sees 14 named storms, seven hurricanes, and three major hurricanes. ## The second week of September has typically been the most active time of hurricane season. But this year's map is blank.

Jonathan Erdman
2026 Atlantic hurricane season peak September 10 quiet
